claims.evidence: No manufacturer nameplate, part number sticker, or engine code stamp is legible on the block or components; no model/VIN tag visible in the photo.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from the claimed vehicle (no Lexus 'LX460' model actually exists as named; could be LX470/LX570 or an unrelated engine)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of engine block casting number, ECU label, or VIN plate matching a genuine Lexus engine code
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified used engine, not as Lexus-specific part

risks.risk: Unknown running condition - may not start or have internal wear/damage
risks.proof: Video of engine cranking/running with audio, plus compression test readout

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/hours and history (accident, flood, overheating)
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or import/customs paperwork

risks.risk: Incompleteness - sensors, turbo, injectors, ECU may be missing or sold separately
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing all sides including rear/intake/exhaust manifolds
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming bare block with only visible accessories, missing parts not included

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/catalog image rather than the actual unit for sale (watermark 'VICTOR NAZECO' and unexplained caption 'SPARK 30C' do not correspond to anything on the engine itself)
risks.proof: New photo of the exact engine taken today with a handwritten date/seller name note next to it
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified listing photo; price based on worst-case generic used engine only

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, leaks, or prior repairs not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Close-up shots of block seams, oil pan, head gasket area, and underside

proof_requests: Close-up of engine code/casting number or any legible nameplate
Video of engine attempting to start or running with sound
Photos from all sides (front, rear, both flanks, top, underside)
Any import/customs document or donor vehicle photo showing odometer
A fresh photo taken today proving current possession, not a reused stock image
response.reason: The witness confirms only a generic used engine assembly with no legible brand/model markings, so the seller's specific Lexus claim and running condition remain unverifiable and must be priced at worst case as a generic, unverified used engine pending proof.
